authors_reviews.title: boAt Airdopes 141 TWS Earbuds
authors_reviews.text: boAt Airdopes 141 ka overall experience bahut achha raha. Sound quality clear aur enjoyable hai, music aur videos dono ke liye listening experience kaafi satisfying hai. Earbuds lightweight hain aur kaan mein comfortable fit hote hain. Battery backup bhi impressive hai, isliye baar-baar charging ki tension nahi hoti. Charging case compact hai aur easily carry kiya ja sakta hai. Design stylish hai aur build quality bhi achhi feel hoti hai. Price ke according features, performance aur overall quality kaafi satisfying hai. Overall, daily use ke liye ek reliable aur value-for-money TWS earbuds.”

authors_reviews.title: Two Orders, Both Defective — Extremely Disappointing!
authors_reviews.text: ⭐ Even 1 Star Feels Too Much — Extremely Disappointing Experience!I ordered these earbuds twice, thinking that maybe the first one was just a defective piece. Unfortunately, my experience was terrible both times.The first pair arrived scratched and was not working at all. I returned it and placed another order, hoping the second one would be new and properly working.But the second pair was even worse. The earbuds were not working, the charging case had visible scratches, and the condition of the product made it look like it had already been used. The most shocking part was that there was even hair stuck on the case. This is absolutely unacceptable for a supposedly new product.So my experience was:❌ First order — defective❌ Scratches on the product❌ Second order — defective again❌ Scratches on the case❌ Hair stuck on the case❌ Earbuds still not workingAnd the problem doesn't end with the defective product.First, I waited for the order → received a defective product → returned it → waited again for the second order → received another defective product → had to return that one too.Now I am also waiting for my refund.According to my Amazon refund timeline, the return was picked up on Aug 27, the return is expected to be received on Sep 3, the refund is expected to be issued on Sep 9, and the refund may be credited to my account by Sep 16.That means your money can remain stuck for many days after returning a defective product. In my case, ₹1,599 is tied up while I wait for my own money to come back.Two orders. Two defective products. Scratches. A used-looking condition. Hair stuck on the case. And then a long wait for the refund.This has been one of my worst online shopping experiences.⚠️ My personal advice: Read the recent reviews carefully before buying this product. I definitely would NOT recommend it based on my experience.NOT RECOMMENDED. SAVE YOUR TIME, MONEY & HEADACHE. 😡

authors_reviews.title: great product under low price range
authors_reviews.text: Pros:1. The level of volume it gets to, is just awesome, it can get incredibly loud so if you're at the gym, these are perfect.2. Awesome Bass!3. Noise cancellation is just great, if you simply put them on without even any music playing, u won't be able to hear things around u very well, it's great for places like Gym.4. Lovely battery life, I've had them a week and only had to charge the case once, that too for just a few minutes. And the earbuds themselves, leave them in case for just five min and you'll be getting battery for a long long while.5. They are very comfortable, can be used for long periods of time.6. Affordable!7. The touch controls are very responsive, tap to pause, double tap right one for next song, double tap left one for either rewind or previous song. Can also pick up calls just by tapping.8. Multiple ear coverings are provided with it.9. Type C portCons:1. The sound quality is not bad or anything but it is slightly muffled as compared to good quality headphones etc. The bass is the highlight so it's great for music, but for movies or gaming, you won't get the most crisp audio.2. Some connectivity issues, sometimes i have to turn my Bluetooth on and off many times for it to work (this is occasional, not a daily or frequent occurrence) [Edit after 1 month use: it's now a very frequent issue]3. The mic quality is good if you are using your phone, but for some reason the quality is really bad if you are on PC4. Sometimes on WhatsApp, the mic will not be detected if you are on call with these earbuds, so you will end up having to take them off to accept a call sometimes. (Not an issue if you are the one dialing) i hope it's just a whatsapp issue rather than earbuds issue.Overall, I needed these for my gym since they play horrible music there (lol) so I'm very very happy with themHighly recommended for music and/or as a more affordable option as compared to JBL etc.
authors_reviews.author: Dillip

authors_reviews.title: USED THESE EARPHONES FOR 1.5 YEARS. HIGHLY SATISFIED!!!!
authors_reviews.text: I have used these earphones for 1.5 years now. Finally now it's showing signs of dying 😭. And not that they have stopped functioning or anything, just the box isn't holding battery for longer periods now. It only charges my earphones once before fully draining. Nonetheless, these earphones have sustained very rough use, at times tolerating more than 6 hours of use at once. For such a price, 1.5 years is much more than anything I could've asked for. I repeat, they still function perfectly fine, the issue is in the box, which has only come up recently. Moreover, they are very light and highly portable. Even tho it's white, it's still squeaky clean, and hasn't taken up any stains. Highly satisfied with my purchase. Go for it. Seriously.
authors_reviews.author: Samridhi Shekhar
